title: Typing a style prop with React.CSSProperties

slides.say: Passing a style object through your own component? Give it a real type, not just object.
React dot CSS Properties describes every CSS property React accepts in a style object.

slides.code:
<Box style={{ color: 'red' }} /> // ✅
<Box style={{ colour: 'red' }} />
// 🔴 not a CSS property
slides.say: You get autocomplete for property names, and typos like colour with a U are caught before they silently do nothing.
